meta.name: keyword-research
meta.description: Discover, analyze, and prioritize keywords for SEO and GEO content strategies from a seed keyword or niche. Identifies high-value opportunities based on search volume, competition, intent, and business relevance. Generates topic clusters. For building a dated editorial calendar from your own Search Console data, use `content-planner` instead — this skill is seed-driven keyword discovery, not calendar scheduling. Use when asked to "find keywords", "keyword research", "keyword analysis", "search volume", "keyword difficulty", "content ideas from a seed", or any keyword discovery task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从种子词发现高价值关键词和话题集群
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为网站或内容找到有搜索量的关键词
copy.tagline_en: Discover high-value keywords and topic clusters from a seed term
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find searchable keywords for your website or content

howto.what: 装好后，它会基于种子关键词或行业做关键词研究：生成关键词清单、按搜索意图分类、评估竞争难度、计算机会分，并把关键词归入主题集群，最后输出含摘要、机会、集群、内容日程和下一步的报告。
howto.when: 当你说“找关键词”“关键词研究/分析”“搜索量”等，或要求围绕某个主题找内容选题时触发。

say.text: 帮我研究“项目管理软件”的关键词
say.note: 会生成关键词清单、难度和机会分。

say.text: 找出低竞争、带商业意图的“健身器材”关键词
say.note: 按意图筛选并按机会排序。

say.text: 分析“best seo tools”的搜索量和关键词难度
say.note: 会给出评分并归入主题集群。

howto.what_en: It generates keyword lists from a seed term or niche, classifies intent, scores difficulty and opportunity, groups keywords into topic clusters, and produces a report with summary, opportunities, clusters, content calendar, and next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to 'find keywords', 'keyword research/analysis', 'search volume', or any keyword discovery task, such as planning content strategy or entering new topics.

say_en.text: Research keywords for project management software.
say_en.note: Returns keyword list, difficulty, and opportunity scores.

say_en.text: Find low-competition, commercial-intent keywords for fitness equipment.
say_en.note: Filters by intent and ranks by opportunity.

say_en.text: Analyze search volume and difficulty for 'best seo tools'.
say_en.note: Scores it and maps it into a topic cluster.
